```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(data.table)

library(DT)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
options(tinytex.verbose = TRUE)

filter_peak_year <- function(x, buffer = 5) {
  x <- sort(x)
  out <- x[1]
  for (yr in x[-1]) {
    if (yr - tail(out, 1) >= buffer) {
      out <- c(out, yr)
    }
  }
  out
}
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, out.width="70%", fig.align="center"}

ymean <- mean(dat$mm)
yrange <- range(dat$mm)
scale_factor <- max(dat$mm, na.rm = T) / max(abs(dat$pgc), na.rm = T)
y2range <- yrange/scale_factor
y2max <- y2range[2] 
y2min <- min(range(dat$pgc, na.rm = T))
scale_factor2 <- (yrange[2] - yrange[1])/(y2max-y2min)
offset <- yrange[1] - (y2min) * scale_factor2

over_100 <- which(dat$pgc >= 1)
sign_change <- which(diff(sign(diff(dat$pgc))) != 0) + 1

peak_year <- sort(dat$Year[intersect(over_100, sign_change)] - 1)

peak_year_filtered <- filter_peak_year(peak_year, 5)


p <- ggplot(dat) +
  geom_line(aes(Year, mm)) +
  geom_line(aes(Year - 1, pgc * scale_factor2 + offset),
            color = "skyblue2") +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = ymean, color = "Mean Ring Width", linetype = "Mean Ring Width")) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = scale_factor2 + offset, color = "PGC = 1", linetype = "PGC = 1")) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 0.5 * scale_factor2 + offset, color = "PGC = 0.5", linetype = "PGC = 0.5")) +
  #geom_vline(aes(xintercept = peak_year, color = "Peak year", linetype = "Peak year"), linewidth = 1.1) +
  scale_color_manual(name = NULL,  values = c("Mean Ring Width" = "darkgray", "PGC = 1" = "red1",
                                              "PGC = 0.5" = "green1", "Peak year" = "skyblue2")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(name = NULL, values = c("Mean Ring Width" = "solid", "PGC = 1" = "dashed",
                                                "PGC = 0.5" = "dashed", "Peak year" = "dotted")) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Ring Width (mm)", sec.axis = sec_axis(~ (. - offset) / scale_factor2, name = "PGC/100")) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = yrange) +
  theme_bw(4) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        #legend.direction = "horizontal",
        #legend.box = "horizontal",
        axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = "steelblue"),
        axis.text.y.right  = element_text(color = "steelblue"),
        axis.ticks.y.right = element_line(color = "steelblue"))

if (!is.null(peak_year_filtered) && length(peak_year_filtered) > 0 && !all(is.na(peak_year_filtered))) {
  p <- p +
    geom_vline(
      data = data.frame(peak_year_filtered = peak_year_filtered),
      aes(xintercept = peak_year_filtered,
          color = "Peak year",
          linetype = "Peak year")
    )  +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = mean(range(dat$Year)),
      y = yrange[2]*0.97,
      label = paste0(
        "Year of Release: ",
        paste(peak_year_filtered, collapse = ", ")
      ),
      vjust = -0.5,
      color = "steelblue"
    )
}


ggsave("plot.png", p, width = 600, height = 400, units = "px")

knitr::include_graphics("plot.png")

```

#### All Cores in the Sample Site

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, out.width="100%", fig.align="left"}

p2 <- dat %>%
  filter(Site_ID == site_id) %>%
  mutate(Tree_ID = as.factor(Tree_ID)) %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(aes(x = Year, y = mm, group = Tree_ID, col = Tree_ID)) +
  geom_line(aes(x = Year, y = mm, group = Tree_ID, col = Tree_ID)) +
  facet_wrap(~Species,  ncol = 3) +
  force_panelsizes(
    cols = unit(3, "cm"), 
    rows = unit(2, "cm")
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) as.integer(x)) +
   guides(
    color = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE)
  ) +
  theme_bw(4)+
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        legend.direction = "horizontal",
        legend.box = "horizontal",
  legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm")
  )

ggsave("plot2.png", p2, width = 1200, height = 700, units = "px")

knitr::include_graphics("plot2.png")
```

#### Stem Map

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, out.width="90%", fig.align="center"}

measyear <- cores_wide %>%
  filter(Site_ID %in% site_id, Tree_ID == tree_id) %>%
    pull(file_year) %>% unique()

visitnum <- cores_wide %>%
  filter(Site_ID == site_id) %>%
  pull(Visit_ID) %>% unique()

if (is.na(visitnum)) visitnum <- 1

treeset <- treedat_pub %>%
  filter(SITE_IDENTIFIER == site_id, VISIT_NUMBER == visitnum)

treemap <- stemMapping(objectID = treeset$TREE_NO,
                       bearing = treeset$AZIMUTH,
                       distance = treeset$DISTANCE,
                       plotShape = "circle",
                       plotSize = 11.28,
                       distanceUnit = "m",
                       outputFormat = "table",
                       showID = TRUE) 

treemap1 <- treemap %>%
  left_join(treeset %>% 
              select(TREE_NO, SPECIES, DBH, HEIGHT, LV_D, SUIT_SI, RESIDUAL, COMP_CHG) %>%
              mutate(objectID = as.character(TREE_NO)),
            by = c('objectID')) %>% data.table()

  
if (visitnum > 1){

p3 <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = treemap1 %>% filter(objectID == "plotboundary"), 
             aes(x = x, y = y), colour = "darkgray") +
  geom_point(data = treemap1 %>% filter(objectID != "plotboundary"), 
             aes(x = x, y = y, col = SPECIES, shape = COMP_CHG, size = HEIGHT)) +
  geom_point(data = treemap1 %>% filter(objectID != "plotboundary", !is.na(SUIT_SI), SUIT_SI == "Y"), 
             aes(x = x, y = y, shape = "SITE_TREE")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("D" = 2, "I" = 3, "M" = 1, "S" = 16, "SITE_TREE" = 4)) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.5, 3)) + 
  geom_text(data = treemap1 %>% filter(objectID != "plotboundary", !is.na(SUIT_SI), SUIT_SI %in% c("Y", "N")),
            aes(x = x, y = y, label = objectID),
            vjust = 1.5) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = paste0(site_id))+
  coord_equal() +
  theme_bw(5) +
theme(
  legend.title = element_text(size = 5),
  legend.text = element_text(size = 4),
  legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
  legend.key.height = unit(0.3, "cm"),
  legend.spacing.y = unit(0.1, "cm")
)

} else {

p3 <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = treemap1 %>% filter(objectID == "plotboundary"), 
             aes(x = x, y = y), colour = "darkgray") +
  geom_point(data = treemap1 %>% filter(objectID != "plotboundary"), 
             aes(x = x, y = y, col = SPECIES, shape = LV_D, size = HEIGHT)) +
  geom_point(data = treemap1 %>% filter(objectID != "plotboundary", !is.na(SUIT_SI), SUIT_SI == "Y"), 
             aes(x = x, y = y, shape = "SITE_TREE")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("L" = 16, "D" = 1, "SITE_TREE" = 4)) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.5, 3)) + 
  geom_text(data = treemap1  %>% filter(objectID != "plotboundary", !is.na(SUIT_SI), SUIT_SI == "Y"),
            aes(x = x, y = y, label = objectID),
            vjust = 1.5) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = paste0(site_id))+
  coord_equal() +
  theme_bw(5) +
theme(
  legend.title = element_text(size = 5),
  legend.text = element_text(size = 4),
  legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
  legend.key.height = unit(0.3, "cm"),
  legend.spacing.y = unit(0.1, "cm")
)

}


ggsave("plot3.png", p3, width = 600, height = 500, units = "px", scale = 1.5)

knitr::include_graphics("plot3.png")
```


#### Damage Agent of Dead Trees


```{r}

measyear <-  year

visitnum <- cores_wide %>%
  filter(Site_ID == site_id) %>%
  pull(Visit_ID) %>% unique()

if (is.na(visitnum)) visitnum <- 1

a <- treedat_pub %>%
    filter(SITE_IDENTIFIER == site_id, VISIT_NUMBER == visitnum, LV_D == "D") %>%
  filter(is.na(DAM_AGNA) |  (!grepl("U", DAM_AGNA) & DAM_AGNA != "O")) %>%
    select(TREE_NO, SPECIES, LV_D, DAM_AGNA) 

if (nrow(a) > 0) a else "No data available."
```
